newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor regains initiative at reduced levels.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor regains initiative at reduced levels.

text.p: Indian castorseed June delivery prices on Tuesday bounced back from 1,101/1,102 rupees to 1,109/1,110 rupees per quintal on fresh speculative buying at reduced levels, dealers said.

Overseas buying however remained sluggish but a drop in arrivals prompted short-covering at the lower levels. Arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region fell to 35,000 bags (75 kg each) against 45,000 bags reported on Monday.
Groundnut oil slid by 3/4 rupees at 364/365 rupees per 10 kg on demand resistance while fresh summer crop arrivals prompted profit-taking.
Imported palm-oil moved down by 2/3 rupees at 284/285 rupees per 10 kg on increased offerings by the importers following rising arrivals at the Bombay port.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil was quoted steady at 560/565 rupees per 15 kg.
